title: Shade Shelter for Redmond Park

onscreen_lines.desc: Firm fixed price for the purchase and delivery of Shade Shelter materials - City staff will construct a four-sided ribbed steel roof & tubular steel frame shelter, 20'x24'. - 20' wide x 24' long, gable end tubular steel frame - Ribbed steel roof with 2x6 tongue and groove decking beneath - Building shall have an 18-inch to 2.0' eave on all sides - Color chosen by owner upon selection - Pricing shall include all materials, signed & sealed drawings by an Iowa licensed engineer, and shipping to destination
